authority_policy: Arnold Murray primary; Dennis Murray clearly attributed secondary. Preserve variants; never combine different claims as a quotation.
frequency_policy: Most asked among reviewed passages. One count per question per distinct recording group. Alternate uploads count once. These are lower bounds while review continues.

questions.question: Is cremation a sin, or does it affect life after death?

answers.summary: He teaches that cremation does not prevent life after death: the flesh returns to the earth, while the spirit returns to God. He distinguishes the temporary flesh body from the spiritual body.

questions.question: Will we recognize our loved ones in heaven?

answers.summary: Arnold teaches that family members remain recognizable in spiritual bodies. He points to Ezekiel 44 in his explanation of the millennium.
He teaches that people can recognize their loved ones in spiritual bodies. In these answers he points to the family relationships described in Ezekiel 44 during the millennium.

questions.question: Must Satan be born of a woman before appearing as the antichrist?

answers.summary: Arnold answers no. He teaches that Satan is cast down fully formed, referring to Michael and his angels casting him out in Revelation 12.
He teaches that Satan does not need to be born as a human to appear as the antichrist. These answers describe him as a supernatural being rather than a flesh child.

questions.question: Did Pastor Murray’s warnings about drugs include prescribed medication?

answers.summary: Arnold distinguishes prescribed medication from drug use for intoxication. He says medication is acceptable and tells listeners not to stop prescribed medicine without speaking to their physician.
He distinguishes medicine prescribed for a medical need from drug misuse. These answers do not treat taking prescribed medication as a sin.

questions.question: What did Pastor Murray mean by the unforgivable sin?

answers.summary: He identifies it with one of God’s elect refusing to let the Holy Spirit speak when delivered before the antichrist. These answers refer to Luke 12:10 and distinguish that situation from ordinary doubts or sins for which a person can repent.

questions.question: Where should someone send their tithe?

answers.summary: Arnold teaches that a person should tithe where they receive instruction in God’s Word. In this answer about past years without tithing, he tells the questioner not to become consumed with that past if they were not being spiritually fed.
He teaches that tithes go where a person is taught God’s Word, to support that teaching. He distinguishes this from love offerings given for other needs.

questions.question: Why did Christ preach to those who had already died?

answers.summary: He teaches that Christ preached to those who died before the crucifixion so they could hear the gospel and have an opportunity to accept salvation. He refers to 1 Peter 3 and 4.

questions.question: Why does Pastor Murray teach five months rather than forty-two months?

answers.summary: Arnold teaches that the period was shortened. He identifies the five months in Revelation 9:5 and 9:10 with Satan’s tribulation and connects this with the shortening described in Mark 13.
He teaches that the period was shortened from forty-two months to five months, connecting the shortening of the tribulation with Revelation 9.

questions.question: How did the pastors explain the Father, Son and Holy Spirit?

answers.summary: He explains the Father, Son and Holy Spirit through God, Jesus as Emmanuel, and the Spirit of God. He uses Jesus’ teaching in John 14 to explain their unity.

questions.question: Did Arnold teach that Noah’s flood covered the whole earth?

answers.summary: Arnold says it probably did not cover the whole world. He explains its extent through his interpretation of its purpose in Genesis 6.

questions.question: Does backsliding require being baptized again?

answers.summary: Arnold answers no and tells the listener to repent. He says Christ’s salvation did not fail when the believer drifted away.

questions.question: Does the antichrist come from Africa?

answers.summary: Arnold rejects that interpretation. He says Revelation’s lion imagery concerns deception and identifies Revelation 12 as his explanation of Satan being cast from heaven.

questions.question: Does the church escape the tribulation through a rapture?

answers.summary: Arnold rejects a rapture escape and teaches that believers remain during the false Christ’s tribulation. He refers to Mark 13 and the Holy Spirit speaking through those delivered up.

questions.question: How did Arnold connect the two witnesses with shortened tribulation?

answers.summary: In response to this question Arnold says the period has been shortened from three and a half years to five months.

questions.question: How did Arnold describe anointing a sick person?

answers.summary: Arnold refers to James 5 and describes blessing a small amount of pure olive oil, applying it to the forehead, and asking God’s healing in Jesus’ name.

questions.question: How did Arnold distinguish Seth’s lineage from Cain’s?

answers.summary: Arnold says Satan had no part in Seth’s birth. He connects Eve’s description as mother of all living with the lineage through which Christ would come.

questions.question: How did Arnold explain the scattering of peoples?

answers.summary: Arnold connects the scattering and different languages with the Tower of Babel in Genesis 10 and 11.

questions.question: How did Arnold explain the word Easter in Acts 12:4?

answers.summary: Arnold points to Acts 12:4 and says the Greek word refers to Passover. He emphasizes Christ as Passover and rejects Easter customs in this answer.

questions.question: How did Arnold explain “our image” in Genesis?

answers.summary: Arnold distinguishes the plural wording in Genesis 1:26 from verse 27 and relates the discussion to Jesus’ statement about seeing the Father in John 14.

questions.question: How did Arnold interpret Eve being made from Adam’s rib?

answers.summary: Arnold interprets the word rendered rib as a curve and connects it with a feminine DNA helix. This is his stated interpretation, not an independently verified scientific or linguistic conclusion.

questions.question: Is being a stay-at-home mother laziness?

answers.summary: Arnold calls raising a family and caring for a home a full-time job and tells the listener not to regard that work as laziness.

questions.question: Is it acceptable to underline and write notes in a Bible?

answers.summary: Arnold approves marking Scripture and making notes when it helps the reader study and remember God’s Word.

questions.question: Is keeping a cross on a wall idolatry?

answers.summary: Arnold distinguishes a symbol of the crucifixion from an object that someone worships. He says the cross itself should not be worshipped.

questions.question: Were Arnold, Dennis and David Murray pilots?

answers.summary: Arnold answers that they were all pilots.

questions.question: What did Arnold mean by a high Sabbath?

answers.summary: Arnold identifies Passover with Christ and explains Sabbath as rest found in Christ.

questions.question: What did Arnold teach about disability and spiritual bodies?

answers.summary: Arnold says God protects the innocent and teaches that disability will not remain in the spiritual body during the millennium.

questions.question: What did Arnold teach about the two sides of the gulf?

answers.summary: Arnold uses Luke 16 to describe paradise and a separation between its sides. He connects the distinction with resurrection and judgment in his explanation.

questions.question: What does it mean that the hairs of our head are numbered?

answers.summary: Arnold explains it as God’s protection and power over Satan, referring to Luke 21:18.

questions.question: What does it mean to be unequally yoked?

answers.summary: In this answer Arnold explains it as an agreement or partnership that prevents a person from studying God’s Word or exercising faith. He contrasts that burden with taking Christ’s yoke.

questions.question: What sequence did Arnold teach for the antichrist and millennium?

answers.summary: Arnold describes Satan’s five-month appearance, Christ’s coming at the seventh trumpet, the millennium, and Satan’s release for a short season to test people before judgment.

questions.question: When did Arnold say believers change into spiritual bodies?

answers.summary: Arnold agrees with the listener’s description of the change at the seventh trumpet, just before the millennium.

questions.question: Where are the Ten Commandments written?

answers.summary: Arnold points to Exodus 20. In discussing inherited consequences, he says a person is not held responsible for a parent’s sin simply because of parentage.

questions.question: Where did Arnold find a reference to dinosaurs in the Bible?

answers.summary: Arnold interprets the behemoth in Job 40 as a dinosaur and places it in his teaching about the first earth age.

questions.question: Where did Arnold say a sinner goes after death?

answers.summary: Arnold says everyone returns to Christ and distinguishes the two sides of paradise. He relates later judgment to the millennium.

questions.question: Where does a person’s spirit go after death?

answers.summary: Arnold teaches that the spirit returns to the Father when the flesh body dies. In this answer he uses Luke 16 to describe paradise and the separation between its sides.

questions.question: Who did Arnold identify as the false prophet in Revelation?

answers.summary: Arnold identifies the false prophet with the antichrist role and distinguishes that role from Satan himself in his explanation of the lake of fire.

questions.question: Who did Arnold identify as the Kenites?

answers.summary: Arnold identifies the Kenites as descendants of Cain and distinguishes that name from Canaanites. He refers to 1 Chronicles 2:55 in this answer.

questions.question: Who did Arnold identify as the main writer of Psalms?

answers.summary: Arnold says David wrote most of Psalms.

questions.question: Why did Arnold encourage water baptism?

answers.summary: Arnold says Christ set an example through water baptism. He distinguishes the outward act from Christ’s forgiveness of sins.

questions.question: Why did Arnold object to using the NIV for his teaching?

answers.summary: Arnold rejects it for his teaching and criticizes its wording in Isaiah 14 and Ezekiel 13. This summary reports his view rather than independently assessing those translations.

questions.question: Why did Jesus tell Mary Magdalene not to touch him?

answers.summary: Arnold interprets the instruction as not delaying or holding him up before going to the Father, rather than a prohibition on touching him.

questions.question: Why would people still follow Satan after the millennium?

answers.summary: Arnold emphasizes Satan’s power to deceive and treats the multitude described in Revelation 20 as a warning.

questions.question: Will an adopted person know their birth parents in heaven?

answers.summary: Arnold gives a qualified answer: he thinks recognition may occur, but leaves the circumstances in God’s hands rather than making an unconditional promise.

questions.question: Will angels be visible when they come?

answers.summary: Arnold answers yes, explaining that angels can be seen when present in the same dimension.

questions.question: Will people understand the Holy Spirit speaking through believers?

answers.summary: Arnold says the Holy Spirit supplies the words and every language understands them. He connects this with Mark 13 and Acts 2.
